summary: The Designer process gates and how each one counts. block: a violation (exit 1) fails the run. report: a violation is listed under reports and does not fail the run. In every mode a missing, stale or invalid gate (exit 2) still fails the run. requires: the gate's native inputs; a caller that passes none of them gets a not-applicable row with the reason, and a caller that passes some of them gets the gate's own verdict.

gates.reason: Inventories the legacy catalog source tree (packages/designer/src and catalog fills) for one implementation per leaf. A slot-model workspace composes from its pinned candidate files, not from this inventory. Its open findings are legacy debt: duplicate legacy implementations, parked chart fills and leaves with no fill yet. They are reported to the Designer. Retired leaves are excluded at the source (catalog/retired.json).

gates.whenAbsent: Checks a consumer's emitted library (resolved.json, component-index.ts and its dogfood contract). A caller with no emitted library, such as Studio composition, has nothing for it to check. The emitted-library caller passes --site, --library and --contract and is blocked on violations.
gates.reason: Wiring: an emitted library must import only its selected fill sources.
Encodes visual class rules. Owner, 2026-10-30 (P0 shadcn reset): invented render gates are reports. Owner, 2026-11-06: checks, not looks. Its findings go to the Designer's visual pass.
Wiring: every registered slot has an eligible candidate in its default source, and every candidate's cited source evidence is current.
